request:

Which of these agent classes are constructed (the class is called by name, e.g. ResponseAgent()) somewhere in non-test code but are never constructed anywhere in test code? Count only direct constructor calls written in a function or method body; patching or referencing a class without calling it does not count, and a test that calls a function which constructs the class does not count as constructing it. Return their class symbol IDs.

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string).
